## Limits
No limit on tool calls per reply. Each call times out after its server's limit (usually 60 seconds). No time limit on the reply.

## Execution environment
Shell and file tools run on This PC (PC) using PowerShell. Allowed folders: <HOME>\LocalAIStudio\workspace. You may also use other paths on this PC (full paths like C:\Users\name\Documents\file.txt): each call that reaches outside the allowed folders asks the user first, so use them only when the task needs it. Windows system folders, Program Files and the app's own data stay refused even if asked. Relative paths start in <HOME>\LocalAIStudio\workspace. A shell command whose working folder (cwd) is outside the allowed folders also asks first; the app can't see which files a command touches, so say what a command will change. This is the user's real Windows PC: deletes go to the app's trash, but other changes are real, so read before you change anything.
